title: FloodGuard Refund Amount Schedule
content:
**Billing schedule — refunds on the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy**

The refund is the credit balance of the premium account, every payment and credit posted less every charge posted, rounded half-up to the cent, paid to the payer of the most recent payment by the method of that payment; a refund below the tier's refund minimum is not paid.

**Defined amounts**

| Amount | Definition |
|---|---|
| Credit balance | Every payment and credit posted to the premium account (payments received and premium credits) less every charge posted (premium billed, fees, returned payments, additional premium and refunds already issued), rounded half-up to the cent |
| Refundable amount | The credit balance less any amount held back on this premium account against another balance of the customer |
| Refund interest | The refundable amount multiplied by the yearly interest percentage and by the interest days divided by 365, rounded half-up to the cent |
| Payment-method charge | The refundable amount multiplied by the charge percentage for the payment method, rounded half-up to the cent |
| Refund | The refundable amount plus the refund interest less the payment-method charge, rounded half-up to the cent |

**Recipient.** The refund goes to whoever made the most recent payment on the premium account, by the method of that payment.

**Floor.** A refund figure below the tier's refund minimum is not paid.

**Worked example (hypothetical inputs).** A premium account shows a premium of 950.00 billed and a policy fee of 50.00 charged, a payment of 1,000.00 received from the mortgagee's escrow and a premium credit of 310.00.

- Payments and credits posted: 1,000.00 and 310.00, together 1,310.00.
- Charges posted: 950.00 and 50.00, together 1,000.00.
- Credit balance: 1,310.00 less 1,000.00, which is 310.00.
- With nothing held back, no interest days and no charge for the method, the refund is 310.00, paid to the mortgagee by the method of its escrow payment.
